notes: Source PDF header: '5TH NATIONAL ASSEMBLY FROM 1972-10TH JANUARY 1977'. Members are listed 1-150 under region headings (no explicit NWFP heading visible in the extracted text before item 1, but 'PUNJAB' appears before item 26, 'SINDH' before item 108, 'BALUCHISTAN' before item 135); items 1-18 assumed NWFP/Hazara seats, items 19-25 'Tribal Area-I..VII' assumed FATA.

A 'WOMEN CONSTITUENCIES' heading (items 139-144) subdivides by province: 'N.W.F.P' (1 seat), 'PUNJAB' (3 seats), 'SINDH' (1 seat), 'BALUCHISTAN' (1 seat) -- 6 women's reserved seats total, all tagged seat_type=reserved_women, elected_via=indirect. Item 144's printed heading repeats 'Women's Constituency-IV' (duplicate of item 142's numeral) rather than 'VI' as would be expected; transcribed exactly as printed and flagged in raw_constituency.

A 'MNAs BELONGING TO THE MINORITY COMMUNITIES' heading (items 145-150) lists 6 minority/non-Muslim reserved seats 'Minorities Constituency-I' through 'VI', with no province sub-heading given (province left null for these 6 rows; addresses suggest they were geographically spread across provinces but the PDF itself does not label them by province, so no province was inferred). Tagged seat_type=reserved_nonmuslim, elected_via=indirect.

Many rows list two people (an original member plus a by-election successor) sharing one Remarks cell describing the vacancy (death, disqualification, resignation, appointment to another office, election to Senate, etc.) and the replacement. Both people are included as separate member records on the same seat: the original as elected_via=general with the vacancy reason in remarks, the successor as elected_via=by_election with a remark citing the by-election. Counted: 17 such seats with by-election replacements (NW-10, NW-21, NW-36, NW-47, NW-49, NW-53, NW-68, NW-70, NW-71, NW-76, NW-80, NW-84, NW-88, NW-91, NW-113, NW-131, NW-134, NW-136, NW-145) = 19 by-election successor records total once counting Minorities Constituency-I.
NW-33 (Jhelum-II, Mr. Mohammad Amir Khan) is marked 'Expired on 27th August, 1974' with no successor named in the PDF -- transcribed as a single general member with no by-election counterpart.

At the very end of the source document, after the numbered list, two additional unnumbered lines appear: '1. Mr. Nurul Amin Died East Pakistan' and '2. Major Raja Tridiv Roi 248, Shalimar 6/2, Islamabad' -- these have no constituency code or clear seat context (likely legacy references to pre-1971 East Pakistan-elected members of this Assembly's original 1970-73 composition) and could not be reliably mapped to the schema, so they are NOT included as member records; flagged here per instructions to record what is unreadable/ambiguous.

OCR mangling of the type 'Moham m ad' / 'Wom en s' with stray internal spaces was collapsed to normal spelling ('Mohammad', 'Women's') per task instructions; no other spelling changes were made. One row (item 140) prints the given name with the honorific 'Mr.' though the person (Nargis Naim Sandhu) is evidently female -- transcribed exactly as printed without correction.

Total member records produced: general/by-election seats 132 (108 single-member seats + 17 seats x2 people = ... see actual count below) plus 6 reserved_women + 7 reserved_nonmuslim (6 minority seats, one with a by-election successor).
